classification.reason: Native Ollama model execution fails before Codex or the technical-writer skill can produce an answer. The model store symlink is valid, and direct llama-server can load the qwen3.5 model only when explicit CPU-only flags are supplied that Ollama's normal runner invocation does not pass.

root_cause_hypothesis.likely_layer: Ollama 0.30.11 runner invocation on macOS/Apple Silicon
evidence: Ollama wrapper with OLLAMA_LLM_LIBRARY=cpu still starts llama-server without --device none, --no-op-offload, or --no-kv-offload.
Ollama wrapper logs still enter ggml_metal_init and fail to create a Metal command queue.
Direct llama-server with --device none --gpu-layers 0 --no-op-offload --no-kv-offload --no-warmup loads the same model blob.
not_supported_by_evidence: Not a missing external SSD model-store symlink.
Not a technical-writer skill behavior failure.

recommended_next_action: Patch the oss-local runtime lane or Codex profile environment to use a runner path that passes explicit CPU-only llama-server flags, or downgrade/upgrade Ollama to a build whose Ollama wrapper honors CPU-only execution without Metal initialization. Then prove native model execution and codex exec --profile oss-local each complete one turn before rerunning the technical-writer release lane.
